purpose: Authorize publication-grade end-to-end evaluation of the already-frozen V23+V15+V21 RTC policy without erasing the preregistered MODEL_ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT_V4 component diagnostics. This amendment is only valid for FIXED_POLICY_NO_RETRAIN after a clean pre-lock split has been frozen and before any active Final hydraulic outcome is opened.

step1.claim: Sparse causal sensing can reconstruct unobserved hydraulic state with preregistered minimum skill.

transparency.reason: The preregistered V4 Step2 standalone TFV-ranking threshold tests a component-level surrogate claim. The publication research question is the end-to-end fixed RTC policy's closed-loop TFV/PFV/engineering performance. In FIXED_POLICY_NO_RETRAIN mode, the policy cannot be repaired or tuned using the active Validation/Final cohorts, so the scientifically appropriate action is to report the Step2 component failure transparently and evaluate the already-frozen policy end-to-end on independent events rather than block all evaluation or manufacture new truth.
